description: This Java class implements a command strategy for retrieving loan interest pauses by loan ID within a batch processing framework. It interacts with the LoanInterestPauseApiResource to fetch data and serializes the response to JSON.

classes.name: GetLoanInterestPausesByLoanIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A component implementing CommandStrategy that retrieves interest pause details for a specific loan ID by delegating to the LoanInterestPauseApiResource and serializing the response.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to retrieve interest pauses for a loan ID extracted from the request URL, calls the API resource, serializes the response, and constructs a BatchResponse.
